introduction: The `nightshift` package extracts the `night-shift` daemon command from the `af` CLI into a standalone Python package and CLI tool, providing identical functionality, output, and user experience as the former `af night-shift` subcommand.

glossary.4.0.0-rc4: The pre-release version string aligned across all workspace packages (`af`, `nightshift`, `agentfox`) in the current release cycle.
glossary.AF_AGENT: Environment variable (value `1`) that enables agent-mode defaults in `AgentFoxGroup`, activating JSONL output and suppressing interactive prompts.
glossary.AF_CONFIG: Environment variable that overrides the default `.agent-fox/config.toml` configuration file path.
glossary.AF_LOG_LEVEL: Environment variable that sets the logging verbosity for AgentFox CLI tools.
glossary.AgentFoxGroup: A Click group subclass from `agentfox.io` that provides consistent error handling, agent-mode defaults, and `OutputManager` construction for all AgentFox CLI tools.
glossary.JSONL: JSON Lines format — one JSON object per line — used for structured progress event output in `--json` mode.
glossary.OutputManager: A class from `agentfox.io` that manages structured and human-readable output for AgentFox CLI tools.
glossary.SIGINT: POSIX signal sent to a process on keyboard interrupt (Ctrl+C), used to trigger graceful shutdown or immediate abort of the night-shift daemon.
glossary.__main__.py: Python module that enables `python -m nightshift` invocation by defining the package entry point.
glossary.af: The AgentFox orchestrator CLI package (`packages/af/`), from which the `night-shift` subcommand is being removed.
glossary.afspec: A workspace package in the AgentFox monorepo; `nightshift` must not directly depend on it.
glossary.agentfox.io: The module within the `agentfox` core library that provides `AgentFoxGroup`, `OutputManager`, and `common_options`.
glossary.agentfox.nightshift: The namespace within the `agentfox` core library that contains all night-shift business logic and daemon modules.
glossary.agentspec: A workspace package in the AgentFox monorepo; `nightshift` must not directly depend on it.
glossary.app.py: The Click entry-point module in `nightshift/app.py` that defines the `main` function and CLI command.
glossary.common_options: A shared set of Click decorators from `agentfox.io` that attach global options (`--json`, `--verbose`, `--quiet`, `--trace`, `--version`) to a CLI command.
glossary.hatchling: The build backend used by workspace packages to produce distributable Python packages.
glossary.make check: The project-level command that runs linting and the full test suite across all workspace packages.
glossary.night-shift: The standalone CLI command (entry point `night-shift`) that runs the AgentFox fix-only daemon.
glossary.nightshift: The new standalone Python package (`packages/nightshift/`) that provides the `night-shift` CLI entry point.
glossary.pyproject.toml: The PEP 517/518 build configuration file that declares package metadata, dependencies, and tooling configuration.
glossary.testpaths: The `pytest` configuration key in the root `pyproject.toml` that lists directories scanned for test files.
glossary.uv workspace: A monorepo project layout managed by the `uv` Python package manager, where multiple packages share a single root `pyproject.toml` with workspace member declarations.
glossary.--json: CLI flag to enable JSON/JSONL output mode.
glossary.--json/--no-json: Mutually exclusive CLI flags to enable or disable JSON output mode.
glossary.--quiet: CLI flag to suppress informational output.
glossary.--quiet/-q: CLI flag (long and short forms) to suppress informational output.
glossary.--trace: CLI flag to enable trace-level logging.
glossary.--verbose: CLI flag to enable debug-level logging.
glossary.--verbose/-v: CLI flag (long and short forms) to enable debug-level logging.
glossary.--version: CLI flag to display the package version and exit.
glossary..agent-fox/config.toml: Default configuration file path for agent-fox projects.

requirements.title: Remove night-shift from the af CLI

user_story.goal: remove the night-shift subcommand from the af package entirely
user_story.benefit: so that af no longer carries the night-shift daemon and coupling between the packages is eliminated

acceptance_criteria.action: does not register or expose a `night-shift` subcommand in `packages/af/af/app.py`
has the file `packages/af/af/nightshift.py` deleted from the repository with no deprecation stub left in its place
reports an unrecognized command error (Click's default behavior for unregistered subcommands)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Non-zero exit code and Click error message indicating the subcommand does not exist

edge_cases.action: fails CI checks because the af test suite includes a test asserting the subcommand is absent
edge_cases.return_contract: Non-zero exit code from the test runner
edge_cases.error_condition: `packages/af/af/nightshift.py` still exists or `night-shift` is still registered in `app.py` after the change

user_story.goal: create the `nightshift` Python package with the correct structure and metadata
user_story.benefit: so that it can be installed independently and published to PyPI as a standalone tool

acceptance_criteria.action: contains the directory structure: `packages/nightshift/pyproject.toml`, `packages/nightshift/nightshift/__init__.py`, `packages/nightshift/nightshift/__main__.py`, and `packages/nightshift/nightshift/app.py`

declares `name = "nightshift"`, `version = "4.0.0-rc4"`, `description = "Standalone CLI for the AgentFox Night Shift fix daemon"`, `license`, and `authors` matching the `af` package values, with `hatchling` as the build backend
declares direct dependencies on `agentfox>=4.0.0rc4`, `click>=8.1`, `rich>=15.0`, and `duckdb>=1.5.4` in the `[project.dependencies]` section (not as transitive dependencies)
registers the CLI entry point `night-shift = "nightshift.app:main"` under `[project.scripts]`
executes the `main` function from `nightshift.app` via `__main__.py`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Same output and exit code as invoking the `night-shift` entry point directly
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a user installs the `nightshift` package and runs `python -m nightshift`

edge_cases.action: fails a dependency audit check, as these packages must not be dependencies of `nightshift`
edge_cases.return_contract: Dependency resolution error or audit failure
edge_cases.error_condition: `agentspec` or `afspec` are listed as direct or indirect dependencies of `nightshift`

edge_cases.action: fails validation because both must be declared as direct dependencies matching the pattern established in the `af` package
edge_cases.return_contract: Missing dependency error at install or import time
edge_cases.error_condition: `rich` or `duckdb` are omitted from the direct dependencies in `[project.dependencies]`

user_story.goal: get the identical experience from the standalone `night-shift` command
user_story.benefit: so that switching from `af night-shift` to `night-shift` requires no behavior adaptation

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Banner printed to stdout before the daemon start message

acceptance_criteria.action: suppresses the fox ASCII art banner
exposes global options `--json/--no-json`, `--verbose/-v`, `--quiet/-q`, `--trace`, and `--version` via `common_options` from `agentfox.io`
prints the version string using Click's default `version_option` behavior, reading the version from the package metadata
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Exit code 0 and version output containing `4.0.0-rc4`

acceptance_criteria.action: loads configuration from `.agent-fox/config.toml` using the same config-loading mechanism as `af`, respecting `AF_CONFIG` to override the config file path
prints the startup message "Night-shift daemon starting…" and, upon exit, prints summary statistics
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Startup message on stdout; summary stats on stdout at exit

acceptance_criteria.action: emits structured progress events in `JSONL` format to stdout
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: One JSON object per line for each progress event

acceptance_criteria.action: initiates a graceful shutdown, completing in-progress work before terminating
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the first `SIGINT` is received while the daemon is running

acceptance_criteria.action: immediately aborts all in-progress work and terminates
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a second `SIGINT` is received during graceful shutdown

acceptance_criteria.action: exits immediately with a descriptive error message
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Exit code 1 and error message on stderr
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a startup failure occurs (e.g. invalid config or missing dependency)

acceptance_criteria.action: uses `AgentFoxGroup` from `agentfox.io` as its Click group, inheriting consistent error handling, `OutputManager` construction, and `AF_AGENT` env-var agent-mode defaults

supports all environment variables provided by `AgentFoxGroup` and `common_options` from `agentfox.io`, including at minimum `AF_CONFIG`, `AF_LOG_LEVEL`, and `AF_AGENT`, with no env var supported by the former `af night-shift` silently dropped

edge_cases.action: exits with a descriptive configuration error
edge_cases.return_contract: Exit code 1 and a human-readable error message on stderr
edge_cases.error_condition: the `.agent-fox/config.toml` file is missing or malformed

edge_cases.action: activates agent-mode defaults (JSONL output, suppressed interactive prompts) as provided by `AgentFoxGroup`

execution_paths.title: User runs night-shift daemon in normal mode

steps.action: Invokes `night-shift` from the terminal (no `--quiet` or `--json` flags)
Initializes `AgentFoxGroup`, constructs `OutputManager`, loads `AF_CONFIG` or default `.agent-fox/config.toml`
Displays the fox ASCII art banner on stdout
Prints "Night-shift daemon starting…" to stdout
Runs the fix-only daemon loop, processing tasks until interrupted
Sends first `SIGINT` (Ctrl+C)
Initiates graceful shutdown, completes in-progress work, prints summary statistics, exits with code 0

execution_paths.title: User runs night-shift in JSON/agent mode

steps.action: Invokes `night-shift --json` (or sets `AF_AGENT=1` in the environment)
Initializes `AgentFoxGroup` with agent-mode defaults, suppresses banner output
Emits structured `JSONL` progress events to stdout for each daemon action
Sends first `SIGINT` to stop the daemon
Gracefully shuts down and exits with code 0, emitting a final JSONL summary event

execution_paths.title: User sends a second SIGINT for immediate abort

steps.action: Sends first `SIGINT` while daemon is running, triggering graceful shutdown
Begins graceful shutdown sequence
Sends second `SIGINT` before graceful shutdown completes
Immediately aborts all in-progress work and exits with code 130
Invokes `night-shift --version`
Reads version from package metadata (`4.0.0-rc4`) using Click's `version_option` and prints it to stdout
Exits with code 0

execution_paths.title: Developer runs full CI check including nightshift tests

steps.action: Runs `make check` in the monorepo root
Reads `testpaths` from the root `pyproject.toml` and discovers `packages/nightshift/tests/`
Collects and runs all tests in `packages/nightshift/tests/`, including the entry point integration test
Reports pass/fail results for all nightshift tests alongside `af` and `spec` test results

execution_paths.title: User invokes af night-shift after removal

steps.action: Invokes `af night-shift` after the extraction is complete
Looks up `night-shift` in its registered subcommands and finds no match
Prints Click's unrecognized-command error and exits with a non-zero exit code

error_handling.condition: `.agent-fox/config.toml` is missing or malformed when `night-shift` starts
error_handling.behavior: The CLI prints a descriptive configuration error to stderr and exits with code 1

error_handling.condition: A startup failure occurs (e.g. missing dependency, import error, bad config)
error_handling.behavior: The CLI prints a descriptive error message to stderr and exits with code 1

error_handling.condition: A second `SIGINT` is received during graceful shutdown
error_handling.behavior: The daemon immediately aborts all in-progress work and exits with code 130

error_handling.condition: User invokes `af night-shift` after the subcommand has been removed
error_handling.behavior: The `af` CLI reports an unrecognized command error via Click's default behavior and exits with a non-zero code

error_handling.condition: `night-shift` entry point is not installed in the test environment when the integration test runs
error_handling.behavior: The integration test fails or is skipped with a descriptive message indicating the entry point is missing

error_handling.condition: Any documentation file under `docs/` or `README.md` contains the string `af night-shift` after implementation
